limitations: The motivating communication result is extremely recent and the quotient deduction is concise, so near-simultaneous or folklore priority risk is material.
provenance: The communication construction is an XOR function. Its sampled address stage and fully linear verification stage descend to parity queries, while its monochromatic-rectangle bound transfers to a codimension lower bound for monochromatic affine subspaces of the XOR quotient.
record_title: Efficient randomized parity queries without large monochromatic affine subspaces
